Name: Large Meadow Farm
Author: Zinnalynn
Description:
[b][size=5]♥ To clarify, this is for a NEW farm save. It will not replace your current meadow farm. ♥[/size][/b]
[size=3]
This map is intended for a group of 8, which is why it's so big! Or if you play solo, but want a ton of space. There's the chewy blue grass, a coop and starter chicks. It's got fishing, foraging, a small beach, and a quarry. The quarry has a mine cart linked to the existing system, so it will work after you unlock them. There's also a new Hot Spring area you can access after upgrading your tools. The Hot Spring works like the spa! The starter quest is still to get parsnips. Enjoy![/size]

p.s. It's named ModdedMeadowFarm in your mods folder!

p.p.s. If you have been running this Farm you will not get the coop, the coop will only apply to new saves!

Downloads.Description: It was brought to my attention that it was possible to walk into the water by the bridges. That has been fixed. I removed a bush, and moved another. There's also a new path. Also "probably" fixed crab pots.
